installPolicy: Standard-library bootstrap installs exact hashed Python wheels and the npm lock in the external MotionGit dependency cache. No global Python installation and no protected source copying.
hostTools: existing Python3.13 or an existing uv-managed Python3.13
browser: Use an existing supported browser. Explicit setup may install the standard Playwright Chromium headless shell into its tool-default browser cache when absent.
platformEvidence: Actual macOS execution is checked separately. Windows/Linux portability is not a native hardware acceptance claim.
